reading.action: Floor 2 (dry footing): heat the bar tip and dip it into the water to test what happens
reading.result: FULL-SYNTHESIS READ (low die 5, INT floor carries it). Ember Channel invoke -8 Focus (104->96). DEMONSTRATED: (1) cold deep flood QUENCHES his heat near-instantly (steam, glow dies in ~1-2 breaths) — heat is fragile on this floor. (2) Glut behavior confirmed BOTH ways: warmth-trigger DRAWS the swarm toward the hot point (per floor trigger 'warmth entering the flood'), AND it RECOILS from the Ember-heated bar at contact (fire-gate). margin 9 >= synthesis threshold -> he DEDUCES the herd-to-strand kill: bait with heat + drive the mass onto dry stone where it loses cohesion. No damage (dry footing; Glut can't reach him there). Ember Channel USE = proficiency tick (record; apply to skill rung number once iris-prep delivers the new ladder scale). No System panel (no threshold). Fog intact (rendered as his perception+deduction, no HP/weakness readouts).
